app.name: happn: dating app
app.description: A location-based dating app that helps you find people you've crossed paths with in real life.

verdict.one_liner: Happn tracks your location regularly and shares your contact info with social networks for marketing.
verdict.summary: happn is a location-based dating app from France that collects your geographical position regularly to match you with people you've crossed paths with. The privacy policy states that your email and phone number may be shared with social networks for hashing purposes, primarily to exclude you from happn's own marketing campaigns and to find similar potential users. The app requires a face photo to register, and may collect biometric data from a video of your face for optional profile certification with your consent. happn complies with GDPR and does not collect banking data.
verdict.recommendation_reason: happn's core feature requires regular location tracking, and it shares your email and phone number with social networks for marketing purposes. Consider whether the real-world matching feature is worth the privacy trade-offs.

red.title: Your location is collected regularly to find crossing points
red.plain_english: Happn's privacy policy states that it collects your geographical position regularly when geolocation is enabled. Crossing points with other members are displayed on your profile, but other members cannot see your exact location.

red.title: Your email and phone may be shared with social networks for marketing
red.plain_english: Happn's privacy policy states that it may share your email address and telephone number with social networks and third-party applications for hashing purposes. This is used to exclude you from happn's own marketing campaigns and to help happn reach profiles similar to yours who may be interested in its services. Happn says the existence of your profile will never be disclosed to these similar profiles.

red.title: Biometric data is collected for profile certification with your consent
red.plain_english: Happn's privacy policy states that to certify a profile, it must collect biometric data using a video of your face and compare this data with your profile photos. The policy states the biometric data are immediately deleted after comparison, but the video is stored to reverify your profile if you add or delete photos.

red.title: A face photo is required to register
red.plain_english: Happn's privacy policy states that at least one profile photo containing a person's face is required to register, and your face must be detectable in one of your photos. If your face cannot be detected, you will not be able to create an account.

red.title: Your activity and profile information are used to suggest profiles to others
red.plain_english: Happn's privacy policy states that based on your activity in the application, your position, and the information on your profile, your profile may be suggested to other members. It also states that happn can recommend other members who may interest you via your Shortlist.

green.title: Messages are private and not viewed by Happn staff
green.plain_english: Happn's privacy policy states that messages and voice messages are strictly private, only involve the members involved, and happn's authorized managers do not view these conversations. Messages are only shared in cases of judicial requests or to comply with applicable law.

green.title: Happn does not collect your banking information
green.plain_english: Happn's privacy policy explicitly states that it does not collect or process any banking data, and that Apple's App Store and Google's Play Store handle all payment information.

green.title: GDPR data rights are available
green.plain_english: Happn's privacy policy references rights to access, rectify, delete, and export your personal data under the GDPR. You can exercise these rights by contacting happn support.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: You must upload a photo of your face to create an account. Happn uses the camera for profile photos and optional video calls between matched members.
categories.detail: Mandatory profile photo containing a recognizable face. Face detection used during registration. Optional video calls between matched members only.
categories.policy_excerpt: your first name, age, birthdate, gender, and at least one Profile Photo are required to register... You will not be able to create an account if your face cannot be detected in one of your Profile Photos upon registering.

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Happn collects your geographical position regularly to show you people you've crossed paths with. Your crossing points are displayed on your profile and a map, but other members cannot see your exact location.
categories.detail: Geolocation collected regularly with consent. Crossing points displayed on profile and map. Exact location never shown to other members. City required if geolocation refused.
categories.policy_excerpt: HAPPN will collect your Geographical position regularly. When the Geographical positions of two Members are within a certain radius, HAPPN pinpoints a Crossing point. Your Crossing points will be displayed on your profile, but Members with whom you cross paths can never see your exact location.

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: Happn does not ask for or access your phone's contacts list.
categories.detail: No mention of contacts or phonebook access in the privacy policy.

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: You must upload at least one photo of your face from your device's storage to create a profile. You can add more photos if you want.
categories.detail: Photo upload required for registration. Additional photos optional. Photos analyzed for face detection upon registration.
categories.policy_excerpt: at least one Profile Photo containing a person's face are required to register with the Application... As stated in paragraph 1, the first Profile Photo should be a photo of a person's face, otherwise one of your photos of your face will automatically be put in first position.

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Happn shares your public profile with all other members. It may also share your email and phone number with social networks for marketing with your consent, and works with third-party service providers.
categories.detail: Profile data visible to other members. Email and phone shared with social networks for campaign exclusion and lookalike targeting with consent. Third-party service providers used. Apple and Google handle payments.
categories.policy_excerpt: we may share you email address and telephone number with such entities to exclude you from our Marketing campaigns... If you have given your consent, your data will be shared with these social networks... You may withdraw your consent at any time
concerns: Email and phone shared with social networks for marketing with consent

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: Happn requires your first name, age, gender, and a face photo. It may collect your identity document or biometric data to verify your age or certify your profile with your consent.
categories.detail: Requires first name, age, gender, face photo. Optional identity document verification. Biometric data collected for profile certification with consent. Face detection required for registration.
categories.policy_excerpt: HAPPN reserves the right, subject to your consent, to conduct facial image capture or verify an identity document at the time of registration or during use of the Service... we must collect the his or her biometric data using a video of his or her face, and compare this data with the Member's Profile Photos.

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Happn tracks your activity in the app and shows personalized advertisements based on your age group, gender, and city with your consent.
categories.detail: Tracks activity such as likes, messages, crossings, and transactions. Personalized ads shown in-app based on age, gender, and city with consent. Email and phone shared with social networks for campaign exclusion and lookalike targeting.
categories.policy_excerpt: Activity data (registration date, login dates, on or offline status, interactions with Members and third-party accounts, number of transactions, notifications received, notification preferences, etc.)... Display personalized advertisements on the HAPPN Application with regard to third-party products and services... personalized based only on your age group, gender and the country and/or city where you live.

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Happn is strictly for adults 18 and older. It verifies age in some countries using identity documents.
categories.detail: Terms require users to be at least 18. Age verification conducted in certain jurisdictions using identity documents.
categories.policy_excerpt: The Member must be over the age of 18... HAPPN verifies that users have reached the age of majority, based on an identity document or any other legally accepted proof of age.

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Happn collects your IP address through server logs when you use the app.
categories.detail: IP address collected via server logs when you access the Services.
categories.policy_excerpt: server logs, which may contain information such as IP addresses

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Happn collects your mobile ID, device model, operating system, and advertising ID. The policy states data may be collected with cookies or other tracking tools.
categories.detail: Collects mobile ID, device version and model, OS, language, advertisement ID, application version.
categories.policy_excerpt: Technical data of the cell phone or device (IP, mobile ID, application version, telephone version and model, advertisement ID, etc.)... Data may be collected with cookies or other tracking tools.

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: Happn uses face detection to verify you are a real person when you register. Optionally, with your consent, it collects biometric data from a video of your face for profile certification. The video is stored for re-verification.
categories.detail: Face detection is mandatory for registration. Optional biometric data collected for profile certification with consent. Video of face compared with photos. Video stored for re-verification if photos change.
categories.policy_excerpt: HAPPN must, having obtained the Member's consent, collect the his or her biometric data using a video of his or her face, and compare this data with the Member's Profile Photos... the video will be stored in order to reverify the Member's profile should he or she add or delete other photos.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Happn does not collect or process any banking data. All purchases go through Apple or Google, and happn only receives a transaction number to confirm the purchase.
categories.detail: Apple and Google handle all payments. Happn retains purchase and subscription history but no payment method information.
categories.policy_excerpt: HAPPN does not collect or process any banking data. Apple's App Store and Google's Play Store have opted to refrain from sending certain types data to mobile applications, which includes any banking and financial information.

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can delete your happn account at any time. As a European company, happn gives you rights to access, correct, and export your personal data under GDPR.
categories.detail: Account deletion available. GDPR rights mentioned including access, rectification, erasure, and portability. Contact support for data rights. Some data retained as a hosting service provider under French law.
categories.policy_excerpt: Should the Member not agree with changes made to the TOS, he or she has the option to end the Services and delete his or her Account as per Article 14.3. HAPPN, in its capacity as a hosting service provider, has a legal obligation to retain certain of the Member's data under Article 6-V.A of the French Trust in the Digital Economy Act.
concerns: Some data retained after deletion for legal obligations

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Happn can change its terms at any time and will notify you through the app or by email. If you keep using the app after changes, that means you accept them.
categories.detail: Notified via app and/or email. Continued use constitutes acceptance. Member can delete account if they disagree.
categories.policy_excerpt: The Member will be informed of updates to the TOS via the Application and/or by email... Complete acceptance of the changes is implied by the Member's continued use of the Application's Services following the updates.
